Booking.metaDescription: Send Chef Harena an inquiry about Ethiopian catering or a culinary experience for your event.
Booking.title: Tell us about your event
Booking.intro: Share a few details and Chef Harena will review your request.
Booking.notBookingNote: An inquiry is not a booking. Dates and services are confirmed only after Chef Harena has reviewed your request and agreed the details with you.
Booking.processStep1: You receive a reference number as soon as your inquiry is sent.
Booking.processStep2: Chef Harena reviews your date, guest count and requirements.
Booking.processStep3: You are contacted by the method you chose, to agree the details.
Booking.phoneHint: Include the country code if you are outside Ethiopia, for example +251.
Booking.eventDateHint: Leave empty if you have not chosen a date yet.
Booking.venueHint: City, venue name or address, as far as you know.
Booking.requirements: What would you like Chef Harena to provide?
Booking.requirementsHint: For example the kind of meal, style of service or any dietary needs.
Booking.consent: I agree that Chef Harena may use these details to respond to my inquiry, as described in the <link>privacy notice</link>.
Booking.localBypassNotice: Development mode: the security check (CAPTCHA) is switched off for local testing.
Booking.errorSummaryTitle: Please check {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}}

errors.invalidPhone: Enter a valid phone number (7 to 15 digits).
errors.phoneRequired: Add a phone number for this contact method.
errors.dateNotFuture: Choose a date from tomorrow onwards.
errors.dateTooFar: Choose a date within the next three years.
errors.guestMin: There must be at least 1 guest.
errors.consentRequired: Please accept to send your inquiry.

Booking.rateLimited: Too many inquiries have been sent from this connection or email address. Please try again in about {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
Booking.captchaFailed: We could not verify that this request came from a person. Please complete the security check and try again.
Booking.conflict: This form was already sent with different details. Please reload the page to send a new inquiry.
Booking.unavailableTitle: Online inquiries are not open yet
Booking.unavailableBody: The inquiry form has not been switched on for this website yet. Please check back soon.
Booking.error: Your inquiry could not be sent and nothing was saved. Please try again in a moment.
Booking.networkError: The connection was interrupted, so we cannot tell whether your inquiry arrived. Please send it again: sending the same inquiry again will not create a duplicate.
Booking.successTitle: Thank you. Your inquiry has been received
Booking.successBody: Your inquiry is now awaiting review by Chef Harena. This is not a booking confirmation and it does not confirm availability for your date.
Booking.referenceHint: Please keep this reference and mention it if you get in touch.

Privacy.metaDescription: How the Chef Harena website handles the information you share in an event inquiry.
Privacy.draftNotice: Draft for review. This notice describes how the website currently handles inquiry information. Items marked for review must be completed by Chef Harena, and the notice should be checked by a qualified adviser before launch. On its own it does not establish legal compliance.

AdminBookings.title: Inquiries & bookings
AdminBookings.intro: Event inquiries from the website and their progress. You see the inquiries your role allows.
AdminBookings.emptyAll: No inquiries yet. New inquiries from the website will appear here.

detail.noTransitions: This inquiry is closed. No further status changes are possible.
detail.confirmBody: The change is recorded in the inquiry's history and in the audit log.
detail.confirmConfirmedBody: Confirm only when the date, services and terms have been agreed with the customer.
detail.confirmAssignTitle: Change who this inquiry is assigned to?
detail.confirmAssignBody: The previous assignee will no longer see this inquiry unless they can see all inquiries.
detail.notesPrivacy: Visible only to staff who can open this inquiry. Never shown to the customer.
detail.duplicateWarning: Possibly a duplicate of {reference}: same email, event type and date within 7 days.
detail.notFoundBody: It may not exist, or you may not have access to it.

review.label: Reviewed by a fluent Amharic speaker
review.help: Tick only when someone fluent in Amharic has read this exact text. Your name and the time are recorded. Amharic cannot be published without it.
review.cleared: The text changed, so the review confirmation will be cleared when you save.

confirm.liveEditBody: This version is on the website. Your changes appear to visitors as soon as you save.
confirm.publishBody: Visitors will see it once both the entry and a language version are published.
confirm.unpublishBody: It disappears from the website and returns to draft. Nothing is deleted.
confirm.archiveBody: It is hidden from the website and kept for reference. You can restore it later.
confirm.restoreBody: It becomes a draft again. Publish it when it is ready.
confirm.deleteLanguageBody: This language version is deleted permanently. The other language is not affected.
confirm.deleteEntryBody: The entry and all its language versions are deleted permanently. Images stay in the media library.

languages.title: Language versions
languages.description: Each language is written, reviewed and published on its own. Pages show English when there is no published Amharic version, marked as English.
languages.amharicMissing: There is no Amharic version yet. Until there is, the Amharic site shows the English text, marked as English.
